children: Overview
Hong Kong restaurant operator's H1 revenue fell 12% yr/yr, mainly from weaker Malaysia sales
Company posted wider net loss for the period, citing higher legal and advertising expenses
Outlook
Top Standard plans to expand its restaurant operations in Malaysia and introduce a Hong Kong restaurant brand
Company plans to enter wild mushroom cultivation and processing in China's Yunnan province
Group is exploring event management and other businesses to diversify revenue
Result Drivers
MALAYSIA SALES DROP - Co said revenue decline was mainly due to lower restaurant sales in Malaysia
HIGHER LEGAL AND ADVERTISING COSTS - Co said increase in legal, professional, advertising and entertainment expenses contributed to wider loss
BRAND PROMOTION - Co said it will continue to promote existing restaurant brands to enhance performance
